title: BossySky
description: Polish Author's Boss Plugin for your Minecraft server!
body:
Plugin For Minecraft Paper/spigot 1.21.1 servers that add's custom bosses.

Commands:

/boss - command list
/boss spawn - spawn your Boss
/boss loot - editing loot for player that deals most damage
/boss usunloot - reset loot
/boss reload - reload config

Permissions:
boss.use - use plugin
boss.spawn - spawn boss
boss.admin - edit or reset loot

Plugin by RealSkyLolz
